name: knowledge-compiler
description: Compile everything you read into a self-organizing wiki and topic graph.

scripts.dev: pnpm dev:clean && pnpm db:up && pnpm dev:all
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green,yellow --names web,agent,api,worker "pnpm --filter @kc/web dev" "pnpm --filter @kc/agent dev" "pnpm api:dev" "pnpm api:worker"
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:worker: cd apps/api && uv run arq app.worker.WorkerSettings
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:up && pnpm db:migrate && cd apps/api && uv sync --extra dev --extra local-embeddings
scripts.test: pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm api:test
